ui.taller_nota: Dissolving a wave gives static residue: 1 g per edge, three times as much for a Leviathan. Sanding raises one stat and costs more at each level; it never adds edges (that is a new summon). Nothing is bought. Sanded stats count in practice against the NPC places; in duels between people they do not count yet.

ui.eco_simulacro: practice: nothing here is signed or kept
ui.eco_1: You launched the buoy. Now listen to the ocean: it is noisy. Send a ping: what comes back is a shape.
ui.eco_2: Three echoes came back, and they are dirty: blurred, unstable. Dissolve the worst one. Its static becomes residue.
ui.eco_3: Now sand your favourite with that residue. Sanding raises one stat. It never adds edges: that would be a new summon.
ui.eco_4: Last: paint it with your frequency. Pick your flag. It is yours: nobody else picks your colour.
ui.eco_5: This is your Insignia. You learned the Workshop: dissolve, sand, paint. Now, the open sea.
